syntactic_simplification: Mice are important for neuroscience research. They are a flexible model for scientists to control and study. This helps them learn about the brain. Researchers have often used male mice in experiments. They prefer male mice because of concerns about female hormones. Female hormones can cause changes in behavior. These changes might affect the results of the experiments.
lexical_simplification: Mice are important for studying the brain. They are easy for scientists to manage and examine. This helps them understand how the brain works. Researchers often use male mice in tests. They choose male mice because of worries about female hormones. Female hormones can lead to changes in behavior. These changes might mess up the results of the tests.
paraphrase_or_explanation: Mice are important for studying how the brain works. They are easy for scientists to manage and examine. This helps them understand brain functions better. Researchers often use male mice in their experiments. They prefer male mice because they are concerned about female hormones, which are chemicals that can change how a female mouse behaves. These hormonal changes might affect the results of the experiments, making it harder to get accurate information.
prompt_used: You simplify complex texts by rewriting them in Plain English.
source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important for studying the brain. They are easy for scientists to manage and examine, which helps them understand brain functions better. Researchers often use male mice in their experiments. They choose male mice because they worry that female hormones can change how a female mouse behaves. These changes might affect the results of the experiments and make it harder to get accurate information.
